# Karting Apartment

> Licensed 60 m² holiday apartment in Castel Mella, Lombardy, Italy — ideal for karting fans and peaceful stays near Lake Iseo, Brescia and Northern Italy.

Karting Apartment is a professionally managed short-term rental operated by MI ISEO LAKE HOUSE. Book direct for the best rate, or via Booking.com and Airbnb. Capacity: up to 4 guests, 1 bedroom plus living room with kitchenette. License 017042-LNI-00002. Check-in 14:00–20:00, check-out by 10:00. Guest rating 9.7 / 10 on Booking.com.
